info.title: YeahPay API (SG Transactions)
info.description: Based on YeahPay API Documentation (SG Transactions) 2.1. Request signatures use SHA-512. Join URL, appId, timestamp, version, nonce, the raw request body, and API key in that order with line feeds (ASCII 0x0A), then calculate the digest. The API key is used only for signing and is never sent in a request header.

post.description: Asynchronous payment result notification. Use the complete callback URL when verifying the signature. Return plain text `success` after successful processing. The source document mentions decryption but does not define an encryption algorithm or ciphertext field, so this specification does not infer a decryption structure.

Asynchronous refund result notification. Use the complete callback URL when verifying the signature. Return plain text `success` after successful processing. The source document mentions decryption but does not define an encryption algorithm or ciphertext field, so this specification does not infer a decryption structure.
The platform notifies the merchant when an API-created payment link receives a successful payment.

eventType.description: Event type, fixed to payment_link.paid; absent from ordinary transaction notifications

thirdOrderId.description: Payment-link business order ID, not linkId or merchantLinkNo. Use the link identifiers saved during creation to get link details.

payTime.description: Payment time string; the notification timestamp header still uses milliseconds

requestBody.description: Only successful payments for source=API are sent, excluding failures and refunds. The link notifyUrl takes priority over the merchant default callback; no notification is sent if both are empty. Verify signatures before processing and retain the mapping between payment orders and links.

200.description: Return plain-text success after signature verification and business processing; other responses trigger retries

parameters.description: Notification appid; use its exact received value for signature verification

VersionHeader.name: version
VersionHeader.description: Request version. The common parameter table specifies the fixed value 1.0. The 2.0 value in the signing example conflicts with that definition, so this specification uses 1.0.

SignatureHeader.name: signature
SignatureHeader.description:
SHA-512 signature. The signing text is `URL
appId
timestamp
version
nonce
raw request body
API key`.

returnUrl.description: HTTPS return URL, up to 1024 characters. Omitted or blank values use the approved merchant website. userInfo and fragments are not allowed.

EmbeddedCheckoutCallback.description: Both return and notification URLs need a valid explicit value or default configuration. They are not interchangeable.

merchantId.description: Merchant ID within the appId permission scope

requestId.description: Creation idempotency key, up to 64 characters. Reuse for network retries. The same merchant and requestId return the original PI without comparing new parameters or charging again.

merchantOrderId.description: Merchant order ID, unique within the merchant. Reusing it with a different requestId returns a conflict.

amount.description: JSON integer in the smallest currency unit. Zero is only for CIT new-card binding without a charge. MIT, ordinary payments, and existing-Consent charges require a positive amount. Strings, decimals, and scientific notation are rejected.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, normalized to uppercase by the server; must be enabled for the merchant

payWay.description: Only Mastercard, case-insensitively. MASTER and whitespace are rejected. Omit or use null for available card brands. This filter does not validate the brand of an existing-Consent direct charge.

customerId.description: Platform customer ID, required for CIT/MIT binding and existing-Consent direct charges; also needed to show saved cards. This field alone does not initiate a charge.

deviceId.description: Non-blank device reference for positive-amount CIT direct charges with a valid consentToken only. Must match the buyer-side fingerprint reference. Rejected for ordinary payments, initial binding, or MIT. Reuse on retries.

paymentIntentId.description: PaymentIntent ID; supply exactly one of this and merchantOrderId

merchantOrderId.description: Original merchant order ID; supply exactly one of this and paymentIntentId. Do not use orderId.

city.description: City; required for shipping and billing addresses

streetAddress.description: Non-blank street address, up to 256 characters

billing.description: Billing data saved for this attempt, returned only when available; not reconstructed from later customer profile changes

status.description: Status of the current authentication stage; COMPLETED does not mean payment succeeded

EmbeddedCheckoutNextAction.description: Actions appear only in latest_payment_attempt.nextAction. Let the SDK handle them with the original Token. Merchant queries do not execute Continue.

paymentAttemptId.description: Platform payment attempt ID, not an internal transaction order ID

createTime.description: Record time in the requested Accept-Timezone and service date format; do not append Z to a value without an offset

updateTime.description: Record time in the requested Accept-Timezone and service date format; do not append Z to a value without an offset

amount.description: Creation amount; zero denotes card verification or binding, not a sale
